audience: support teams that answer customer requests in a HelpSpot help desk

useCases.title: Work through a filter of open requests
useCases.text: List the filters you can use, then list the requests in one filter. Open a request to read its notes.

useCases.title: Find all requests from one customer
useCases.text: Search requests by text, customer, status, category, assigned staff or date. Read several matching requests in one call.

useCases.title: Look up ids for searches and updates
useCases.text: List the categories, status types and active staff with their ids. Use these ids to search for requests or to change one.

useCases.title: Add a private note and assign a request
useCases.text: Add a note, or set the assignment, status, category or open state of a request. A public note emails the customer, so use a private note unless they should read it.

useCases.title: Open a new request with a first note
useCases.text: Create a request with its first note and a category. Use a private note, because a public note emails the customer.

useCases.title: Look up saved canned responses
useCases.text: List the canned responses you can see, with their saved text, to pick the right reply before you answer a customer.
